_comment: U.S. Census Bureau International Trade API (the primary U.S. customs
statistics; CBP collects, Census compiles, USITC DataWeb redistributes).
Scoped 2026-09-11 from the Census developer guide; the sandbox cannot reach
api.census.gov, so the first Actions run captures payloads under
from env CENSUS_API_KEY. Monthly data land ~34-36 days after month end
from 2013-01. Use YEAR/MONTH parameters, not time= ranges, on HS endpoints.
HTTP 204 with an empty body means no rows for the query (unpublished or
no trade); HTTP 400 carries an error string naming a bad variable.
The HTS REST API (hts.usitc.gov/reststop) is keyless and snapshots the
code descriptions and units so a renumbering is visible in the repo.

census._get_note: If the API rejects a variable (HTTP 400 naming it), the fetcher drops it and retries once, so a renamed field costs one call, not the run.

_comment: Census I_COMMODITY / E_COMMODITY values. 10-digit codes are the U.S.
statistical suffixes from CBP rulings; 6-digit codes are HS6 aggregates
(safe across renumberings). Verify against data/us/hts_codes.csv after
the first run: the HTS-2022 split of old 8541.40 into 8541.41/42/43/49
puts laser diodes with LEDs (8541.41) per CBP HQ 088628.

imports.8517620090: Optical transceivers and other reception/conversion/transmission machines (CBP N336394, N302251)
imports.851762: HS6 total: machines for reception, conversion and transmission of data
imports.851779: Parts of 8517 apparatus incl. TOSA/ROSA (was 8517.70; ruling N041692)
imports.854149: Other photosensitive semiconductor devices incl. photodiodes
imports.854110: Diodes other than photosensitive or LED
imports.901380: Other optical devices and instruments incl. laser-diode modules with essential optics (HQ 955114)
imports.381800: Doped wafers / chemical elements for electronics (InP, GaAs substrates)
imports.848620: Machines for manufacturing semiconductor devices or ICs
imports.848610: Machines for manufacturing boules or wafers
imports.848640: Machines specified in note 11(C) to chapter 84

exports.854141: LEDs incl. laser diodes (AAOI Sugar Land, Coherent Sherman chip exports)

countries_of_interest._comment: Census 4-digit country codes; used only to label the report, every country is stored.
